sources.name: NYSDEC Boat Launch Sites for Chenango County
observations: Lists Susquehanna River, Afton, at the exact stored coordinate 42.228255 N, 75.523860 W, with the site classified as an unimproved trailer launch and parking for 12 cars and trailers.
The same directory defines an unimproved trailer launch as a site that accommodates a small/light trailer to the water's edge, with the boat pushed on/off in typically shallow areas.
sources.limits: NYSDEC publishes the public launch coordinate and type, but does not label the point as a surveyed wet toe.

sources.name: NYSDEC Susquehanna River access page
observations: Locates the Afton public access at the northeast end of the NYS Route 41 bridge in the Village of Afton and identifies a gravel ramp with parking for 12 cars and trailers.
sources.limits: Confirms ramp type and bridge-side location but does not georeference the exact river-entry toe.

sources.name: NYSDEC Susquehanna River fishing brochure
observations: Lists Afton as a DEC gravel ramp at the Route 41/Maple Street bridge on the northwest shore, suitable for trailers.
sources.limits: The map and description confirm the general ramp location and use, not the precise shoreline coordinate.

sources.name: Google Maps coordinate link from NYSDEC directory
observations: The state directory's Google Maps link resolves to the same published coordinate used by both route endpoints.
sources.limits: A map pin at the listed coordinate confirms the public access locality; it does not independently survey the ramp toe.

decision: Retain the exact NYSDEC-published coordinate as an authoritative launch-site anchor. Do not shift the point without a more precise state coordinate or defensible mapped ramp-toe evidence; leave the mapped-water offset under review.
